## Our mission

At Upstage, our mission is to build intelligence for the future of work. By building advanced language models and document processing engines, we help organizations redefine the way they work — making processes smarter, more efficient, and ultimately more human-centered.

## Our team

Founded in 2020, we’re a dynamic team of 100+ top AI researchers, engineers, and business leaders with a proven track record of building AI solutions trusted by major enterprises worldwide. Our team collaborates remotely, with hubs in Seoul, San Francisco, and Tokyo.

## Our investors

Raised over $100M from incredible investors like SoftBank Ventures Asia, SK Networks, Korea Telecom, Company K Partners, Primer Sazze Partners, and more.
